Anthropic Careers

AI Safety Researcher

San Francisco, CA

About the Role

Anthropic is looking for AI Safety Researchers to work on alignment and interpretability. This is a unique opportunity to work on one of the most important problems of our time.

What You'll Do

  • Conduct original research on AI alignment techniques
  • Develop and test novel approaches to AI interpretability
  • Publish findings in top ML venues
  • Collaborate with a world-class team of researchers

What We're Looking For

  • PhD in machine learning, computer science, or related field
  • Strong publication record in ML/AI
  • Experience with large language models is a plus
  • Genuine concern for AI safety and beneficial AI development

Compensation

Base salary: $200,000 - $350,000. Equity package included. Comprehensive benefits.
